title: Psychedelic Mushroom Oracle
description: A surreal psychedelic artwork features a giant central mushroom with a green spotted cap and dripping orange liquid. Its stem forms a portal containing a blue-skinned female profile with flowing pink and green hair surrounded by twelve circular portraits of colorful stylized female faces. At the bottom, multiple smaller mushrooms grow from the ground amid flames and skulls, while two crowned skeletons with red eyes stand in the lower center.
prompt: Surreal psychedelic artwork with a massive central mushroom with green spotted cap and dripping orange goo forming a circular portal. Inside the portal is a blue-skinned woman in profile with vibrant flowing pink and green hair. Surrounding the portal are twelve circular bubbles containing colorful stylized female faces with varied hair colors. Below are smaller glowing mushrooms growing among skulls and flames, with two crowned skeletons with glowing red eyes standing with arms raised, dark background with swirling smoke and stars.
